subject: Post-signature onramp playbook — embedded MAP + evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cardinalhealthtech.com>, Natalie Brooks <natalie.brooks@cardinalhealthtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature onramp playbook — embedded MAP + evaluation cadence

Hi Amit / Natalie —

Thanks again for signing. Attached are the two artifacts we discussed: a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan, and a focused evaluation plan for the pilot canary phase. The goal here is to make the onramp predictable: clear owners, measurable checkpoints, and a short feedback loop to detect regressions during canary and training.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Week 0: Contract signed + procurement handshake (you) -> access & baseline data snapshot delivered to Redwood.
- Week 1–2: Provisioning + model selection & quantization profile (Redwood infra).
- Week 3: Canary pilot (5% traffic) against production-like dataset, run evaluation plan (attached).
- Week 4–5: Training enablement + runbook handoff (train-the-trainer for ops).
- Week 6: Scale to full production with staged routing and rollback gates.

Key MAP items I highlighted in the spreadsheet: owners, SLO targets, acceptance criteria for the canary, and the roll/pause triggers. Requested input from your side is minimal: a tech contact for access, and confirmation of the production dataset slice for the canary.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Cardinal_v1.xlsx (MAP + timeline), EvalPlan_Cardinal_v1.pdf (test cases, success metrics).

Can we lock a 60-minute workshop next week to walk this together? I’m proposing Wednesday 2026-09-09 10:00–11:00 PT. If that works, we’ll use the workshop to finalize owners and the canary window.

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Naomi —

Received, thanks for the clear plan. Wednesday the 9th at 10:00 PT works for our team. For owners: I’ll be the primary tech contact for the canary, and I’m looping in Procurement for the final provisioning checklist. Natalie will coordinate training recipients.

A couple quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the volume assumptions for the pilot canary (tokens/sec and number of sessions)?
- We need the list of required IAM roles for the VPC access so our security team can provision ahead of the workshop.

We’ll aim to have procurement sign-off by Friday 2026-09-04.

Thanks Amit — great, locking the workshop for 9/9 10:00 PT. Quick answers inline and a short mutual-action table below.

Volume assumptions for the canary (we’ll confirm in the workshop but this is our baseline):
- Steady-state token rate: 60 tokens/sec (per region)
- Pilot sessions: 500 unique sessions over the 72-hour canary window
- Peak bursts: up to 300 tokens/sec for short spikes (we’ll shape traffic)

IAM roles: please provide an admin tech contact and we’ll send a minimal IAM role document (read-only monitor + provisioning write role). I’ve attached a short access checklist in the MAP.

Mutual action highlights (excerpt):
- Cardinal: provision test dataset slice, confirm IAM tech contact (owner: Amit).
- Redwood: deliver quantized model artifact & canary evaluation harness (owner: Marissa).
- Cardinal: procurement sign-off (owner: Procurement).
- Redwood: run canary + share daily evaluation report (owner: Karthik).

We’ll also bring a runbook for rollback & automatic fallback (canary fails -> route to hosted-safe model). Marissa and Karthik will own the technical run. Soojin will lead training materials.

Attached: Redwood_MAP_Cardinal_v1.xlsx (updated with the mutual-action table).

Team —

Thanks — wheel-in checklist for the 9/9 workshop and owners. I’ll bring the canary harness and the automated evaluation dashboards; Karthik, please bring the quantized model artifacts and the fallback policy docs. Soojin, please draft the 90-minute training outline (ops + support).

Pre-work items (complete before 9/9):
- Marissa: build canary dataset snapshot & smoke tests (due 2026-09-06) — attachment: Canary-Checklist.docx
- Karthik: prepare quantization profiles and perf baseline (due 2026-09-07)
- Soojin: finalize training deck & quick reference (due 2026-09-07)

We should also prepare a short demo that shows a regression detection — one crafted prompt and expected outputs, plus the alert that would trigger a rollback. Keep it tight (10 minutes).

Marissa

Redwood Inference
